scenario: certificate already past its expiration date
notes: IPACertmongerExpirationCheck reports ERROR (past expiry, per Red Hat KCS 7007191 / freeipa.org/page/V4/CA_certificate_renewal) so cert-expired DIAGNOSES with HIGH confidence and CRITICAL severity. certmonger itself shows a clean MONITORING/no-error state, so certmonger-tracking-stuck and renewal-master-unreachable both correctly stay silent (no failure state present, and renewal-master-unreachable only considers the WARNING - not ERROR - expiration case, since ERROR/CRITICAL is already a confirmed, direct finding handled by cert-expired).
